# Session Summary

## Goal
Fix a ledger drift bug where invoice totals don't match ledger totals (error: ERR_LEDGER_DRIFT_7731, ledger total 18204 != invoice total 18240, difference of 36).

## Root Cause Found
**Off-by-one error in src/ledger/reconcile.ts at line 218**: the loop uses `<=` instead of `<`, causing one extra record to be processed.

**Race condition in retry logic**: the retry worker read the attempt counter before the transaction committed, allowing two workers to both see attempt=1 and process the same event twice, causing double charges.

## Key Decisions Made
- **Webhook deduplication**: Use Postgres advisory locks instead of Redis (simpler, one less service to run)
- **Webhook retry policy**: Failed webhooks retry after 5s, 25s, 125s, then go to dead-letter table (no fourth retry)
- **Refund webhook age filter**: Ignore events older than 72 hours (per Sam Okafor)
- **Staging config**: Set BILLING_REPLAY_WINDOW_SEC to 900 (production stays at 3600)
- **Database**: Staging host is nw-billing-stg.internal:6543 with pgbouncer in transaction mode
- **Timezone**: Keep America/Chicago for all billing cron jobs; nightly job runs at 02:15
- **Invoice numbering**: Prefix NWB- followed by six digits, starting at 100200
- **Fiscal year**: Northwind's fiscal year starts 1 March; monthly report cutoff is last day of February for year end
- **Stripe sandbox**: Use customer cus_QXa7m2 for all manual tests, never a real customer
- **On-call**: Channel #billing-oncall, pager alias billing-primary
- **Stripe key rotation**: Ask Priya Natarajan (owns the Stripe account) before rotating restricted key
- **Rollback plan**: Redeploy release 2026.09.4 and run scripts/unfreeze.sh; do not touch ledger table during rollback
- **Feature flag**: ledger_v2_reconcile is on for 10% of accounts
- **Rejected idea**: Rewrite in Go; stay on Node (team knows it)

## Files Touched
- src/ledger/reconcile.ts (off-by-one fix)
- src/ledger/index.ts (added CHECK constraint ledger_nonneg_total)
- src/webhook/index.ts (advisory lock deduplication)
- src/refunds/index.ts (72-hour age filter)
- src/auth/index.ts
- src/billing/index.ts
- src/dedupe/index.ts
- src/invoices/index.ts
- src/reports/index.ts
- src/scheduler/index.ts

## Tests Run
Multiple test suites executed (ledger, billing, refunds, webhook, invoices, auth, reports, scheduler, dedupe). Most passed; some failures noted but unrelated to core bug.

## Performance Notes
- Latency before fix: p95 1840 ms
- After batch size change (50→200): p95 610 ms
- Memory leak fixed: invoice cache capped at 512 entries (was 20000, never evicted)
- pg pinned to 8.11.3 (8.12 broke connection pool under load)
- Migration 0047_add_idempotency_index.sql takes ~40 seconds on staging

## Reproduction Command
```
node scripts/replay.mjs --from evt_1Nq8Zx --dry
```

## Shadow Table Created
ledger_shadow_2026 holds shadow copy for total comparison during reconciliation.

## Next Steps
- Deploy fix to staging for validation
- Monitor for ledger drift errors
- Gradually roll out to production with feature flag at 10%
- Increase feature flag percentage after validation period
